source_title: In 1999, Noah Wyle bought an 80-acre ranch; today he lives there with his family, dogs, cats, horses
source_excerpt: 'ER' star Noah Wyle's life on his iconic Santa Ynez ranch is nothing short of every animal lover's dream! The actor had purchased the 80-acre ranch back in 1999. Now, 27 years later, the star is still here, enjoying life. Only this time around, he has his family, as well as three dogs and a "menagerie" of other animals to keep him company.Here is a look into the beloved actor's life on the ranch and how he has been spending his time away from the hustle and bustle of Hollywood.Noah Wyle's quiet life away in his 1999 ranchDuring his interview with Cowboys and Indians in 2019, Wyle opened up about how, while he enjoys the glamour that comes with being one of the biggest stars in the industry right now, he has always been a "somebody" and has invested quite a bit to ensure that his 1999 ranch becomes his safe haven.He further shared, âAnd I have a place up in Santa Ynez, California thatâs sort of my go-to sanctuary," calling it the âLaboratory. Oasis.â He added, âI needed to be geographically close to Los Angeles just for practical purposes, but I didnât want to raise my kids in Los Angeles. I was raised in Los Angeles. Wyle has all kinds of animals on his ranch, including his three dogs, as well as cats, pigs, chickens, a rescue steer, and horses.He concluded that "Ranch life is about life cycles."
